before_scope: Initial eight checks captured three failures before product fix. Final verifier adds three checks for new selection and filter transitions; baseline is not a run of the expanded eleven-check verifier.
implementation: Invalidate generated URL and status on current encoded view, selected identity, snapshot or open lifecycle change in layout effect. Monotonic request sequence prevents stale clipboard settlement from changing UI; newest copy clears previous status immediately.
validation: Strict TypeScript/production build passed; 108 unit tests; 11 targeted checks plus 5 existing list regression groups in each installed Chrome and Edge. Existing list driver does not bind build itself: serial invocation after targeted build with no intervening edits, current build independently checked at archival time.
limits: Controlled clipboard promises and native browser input events; no OS clipboard permission/content, real device or reader proof. Pending OS clipboard work itself is not cancelled by UI invalidation.
Only 390x844 emulated touch viewport for targeted share checks; this is not full 200% or complete browser/device acceptance.
Prior font, touch size, contrast, Firefox, performance and full browser results keep their original build identities.
Full MVP remains active with independent QA, target devices/readers and other required gates incomplete.
